confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of local price levels for July 2026; no live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the more reliable; hostel and hotel anchors vary with district, booking date and summer demand, so treat them as approximate. Cocktail and wine anchors are the weakest and were set from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge of those prices is limited.
comparable_city_reasoning: No listing data used. Benchmarked to Sofia, Bucharest and Budapest-area price levels for restaurants and budget lodging, with the 3-star hotel anchor adjusted for July demand in a mid-sized Central and Southeast European capital.
